description: Election Commission - Mrs. A. A. R. Shriyani of the Tangalle Urban Council has vacated her office of member of that U/C, Mr. S. A. J. N. Maldeniya of Tangalle P/S he vacated his office of that Pradeshiya Sabha - Mr. E. I. Kumara of the Angunakolapelessa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of that P/S
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices declaring that members of local authorities (Tangalle Urban Council, Tangalle Pradeshiya Sabha, and Angunakolapelessa Pradeshiya Sabha) have vacated their offices due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This content specifically relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it an Elections Gazette.
